description: Grid of possible presence of a flood zone (data relating to old generation maps) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The standardized grid identifies sectors for which information on flood zones is available (old-generation maps, flood ratings, etc.). Contact [the municipality or the MRC] ( () to check if flood zone boundaries have been established on old-generation maps for a property. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are DGIG, Flood, Natural risk, Flood zone, Government information. It offers 6 resource(s) in FGDB/GDB, GPKG, HTML, OTHER, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
